semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Bharat Forge Limited is positioned to support the semiconductor ecosystem through its expertise in precision engineering and advanced manufacturing, although it is not primarily a semiconductor supplier.
summary: Bharat Forge Limited is a diversified global enterprise that provides technology-driven engineering and manufacturing solutions, with capabilities that can support the semiconductor industry. The company leverages its strengths in precision engineering and advanced manufacturing to contribute to India's semiconductor ecosystem.

regional_presence.India: Headquartered in Pune, India, Bharat Forge is a key player in supporting the growth of the semiconductor manufacturing sector in the country.
